nvitk.viz.streamlines
=====================

.. py:module:: nvitk.viz.streamlines

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Headless flow tracing: instantaneous streamlines and time-varying pathlines.

.. py:function:: clip_polylines_to_roi(polylines: Sequence[numpy.ndarray], mask: numpy.ndarray, *, label_ids: Sequence[int] | None = None) -> list[numpy.ndarray]

   Clip each polyline in *polylines* to its longest contiguous run inside the mask ROI (dropping empties).


.. py:function:: stream_seed_cloud(mask: numpy.ndarray, n_seeds: int, seed: int | None, *, label_ids: Sequence[int] | None = None, seed_mode: SeedMode = 'volume', seed_plane_axis: int = 2, seed_plane_side: PlaneSide = 'min') -> numpy.ndarray | None

   Random subsample of mask voxel indices (N, 3) for trace seeds.


.. py:function:: resample_polyline(poly: numpy.ndarray, *, spacing_vox: float) -> numpy.ndarray

   Resample a polyline to approximately uniform arc-length spacing.


.. py:function:: resample_polylines(polylines: Sequence[numpy.ndarray], *, spacing_vox: float) -> list[numpy.ndarray]

   Apply :func:`resample_polyline` to every polyline with ≥2 points, dropping ``None``/too-short ones.


.. py:function:: sample_vel_trilinear(frame: numpy.ndarray, pos: numpy.ndarray) -> numpy.ndarray

   Trilinear sample of a (X, Y, Z, 3) velocity frame at fractional voxel position.


.. py:function:: compute_streamlines(velocity_xyz: numpy.ndarray, mask: numpy.ndarray, params: FlowTraceParams) -> list[numpy.ndarray]

   Instantaneous streamlines for one cardiac phase.


.. py:function:: compute_pathlines(velocity_xyzt: numpy.ndarray, mask: numpy.ndarray, params: FlowTraceParams, *, time_start: int) -> list[numpy.ndarray]

   Pathlines integrated forward through the time-varying velocity field.


.. py:function:: vertex_scalars_for_polylines(polylines: Sequence[numpy.ndarray], *, velocity_xyz: numpy.ndarray | None = None, color_metric: ColorMetric = 'speed', dt_seconds: float = 1.0, trace_mode: TraceMode = 'streamlines') -> list[numpy.ndarray]

   Per-vertex scalar values for coloring.


.. py:function:: streamline_mean_speeds(polylines: Sequence[numpy.ndarray], velocity_xyz: numpy.ndarray) -> numpy.ndarray

   Mean |v| (mm/s) along each polyline.
